split_policy: Reuse and checksum the existing per-ratio data split; split_seed=2020, PYTHONHASHSEED=2020.
parameter_source: Author public code at c88e6fe, task 2, and default main.py arguments.
paper_settings_note: The paper reports a pretraining LR grid but does not establish 0.01 as its selected value; this rerun uses released-code defaults, not a claim of exact paper hyperparameter recovery.
